verdict.rationale: Raygun documents smart filters that segment errors by version (release) and custom tags, and it has a search results page. That covers part of the story but not a real query language or cross-project search. Missing for 10: a documented query syntax, cross-project search, explicit environment filtering, filtering by arbitrary custom properties, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and filter events across projects by tag, release, environment, and custom properties with a real query syntax

citations.quote: use smart filters to segment errors by date, location, version, host, OS, browser, and custom tags
Added **error chart** visualization to **search results page**.
